hunt.justification: The Apex Accelerator campaign is a highly polished social engineering operation targeting crypto startups. A successful compromise leads to the loss of code and digital assets. This hunt ensures no persistent payloads or active exfiltration exist in the estate.

scenario.summary: The Apex Accelerator campaign uses malicious npm packages and a fake Web3 platform to target cryptocurrency startups with info-stealing malware. The attack chain involves a supply-chain delivery mechanism that fetches platform-specific executables (Bun/Rust) to retrieve and execute further payloads on Windows and macOS, ultimately exfiltrating data via Telegram.

meta.rationale: Focus on developer workstations and hosts with npm installed. Pay particular attention to macOS endpoints due to the cross-platform nature of CloudSyncD.
meta.hypothesis: An adversary is using Bun-compiled launchers to stage PowerShell and VBScript payloads, impair local security controls, and deploy information stealers that exfiltrate data to Telegram.

hunt.name: Apex Accelerator Post-Delivery Execution and Evasion
hunt.description: This hunt targets the post-delivery phase of the Apex Accelerator campaign (REF8801). It identifies Windows security impairment, such as disabling Smart App Control and adding Defender exclusions, alongside the creation of rare staging scripts. The hunt then pivots to find the execution of secondary payloads like bludness.exe or CloudSyncD and identifies outbound exfiltration to Telegram or attacker-controlled domains. It uses a phased flow to first confirm the staging breachhead before examining the final exfiltration and malware persistence.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, process_cmd_line, user_name, time FROM hb_process_activity WHERE (LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%apex-windows-x64.exe' OR LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%apex-audit-windows-x64.exe' OR LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%apex-darwin-arm64' OR LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%apex-audit-darwin-arm64') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Identify hosts running the primary Apex or Audit binaries that serve as the entry point for the secondary execution chain.
config.expected_signal: A list of hosts running the Apex-branded Bun executables. Absence means the primary launchers have not been observed.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, reg_target, reg_value_data, process_name, time FROM hb_registry_activity WHERE ((LOWER(reg_target) LIKE '%\\verifiedandreputablepolicystate%' AND reg_value_data = '0') OR (LOWER(reg_target) LIKE '%\\exclusions\\\\paths%' AND LOWER(reg_value_data) LIKE '%.apex-audit%')) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Find evidence of Smart App Control disabling or Defender exclusion path additions used by Apex.
config.expected_signal: Registry writes disabling Smart App Control or adding the .apex-audit path to Defender's exclusion list.

primitive_config.label: Identify security impairment
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, reg_target, reg_value_data, process_name, time FROM hb_registry_activity WHERE ((LOWER(reg_target) LIKE '%\\verifiedandreputablepolicystate%' AND reg_value_data = '0') OR (LOWER(reg_target) LIKE '%\\exclusions\\\\paths%' AND LOWER(reg_value_data) LIKE '%.apex-audit%')) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
primitive_config.expected: Registry writes disabling Smart App Control or adding the .apex-audit path to Defender's exclusion list.

config.content: SELECT LOWER(file_name) AS name, COUNT(DISTINCT device_hostname) AS hosts, COUNT(*) AS touches, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_file_activity WHERE instr(',' || '{{staging_files}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(file_name) || ',') > 0 AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY 1 HAVING hosts <= 5
config.description: Find temporary PowerShell and VBScript files used to launch the verification commands, stack-counting across the fleet.
config.expected_signal: Script files like _apex_run.vbs occurring on very few hosts. Fleet-wide files are likely legitimate and should be ignored.

config.objective: Determine if Apex-branded launchers have successfully initiated script-based staging and defense evasion on the scoped hosts.

config.success_criteria: A verdict per host with citations of specific file or registry rows.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, process_cmd_line, parent_process_name, time FROM hb_process_activity WHERE (instr(',' || '{{malicious_binaries}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(process_name) || ',') > 0 OR LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%cloudsyncd%') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Find the execution of final payload binaries like bludness.exe or CloudSyncD on scoped hosts.
config.expected_signal: Processes named bludness.exe or CloudSyncD running on the same hosts that performed staging. High-confidence indicators of infection.
